Signature Bespoke Timeline

Standard Tailoring (1 to 2 Weeks)

Where sartorial mastery meets unhurried precision. Each custom suit or garment is meticulously engineered from scratch to match your exact proportions, posture, and personal style across Kigali.

The Bespoke Journey (1 to 2 Weeks)

01

Consultation & Styling

Meet with our master tailors to discuss your vision, occasion, and select from our exclusive range of premium fabrics and linings.

02

Precision Measurements

Detailed body proportions and posture measurements taken at our Kigali atelier (MIC Building / Norvège) or via private house call.

03

Crafting & Fitting

Hand-cutting and garment construction tailored strictly to your silhouette, followed by precision fittings to guarantee perfection.

04

Final Handover

Professional pressing, final quality inspection, and handover of your flawless bespoke garment within your 1 to 2-week window.

Information Needed For Your Standard Order

  • Garment Specifications: Exact style (2-piece, 3-piece, double-breasted, blazer, or women's executive suit) and intended occasion.
  • Deposit Structure: Standard bespoke orders require a standard deposit upfront to secure atelier cutting time and fabric allocation.
  • Measurement & Fitting: Confirmation of whether you are visiting our Kigali workspace, bringing your own fabric, or utilizing our mobile house call service.
  • Timeline Expectation: Allow 1 to 2 weeks for complete master craftsmanship, fittings, and delivery.
